name: World Clock
author: Widgeter
description: Live local times for the cities you pick, with the offset from your own time and a day/night marker.

config.label: Cities
config.default:
Copenhagen = Europe/Copenhagen
London = Europe/London
New York = America/New_York
Tokyo = Asia/Tokyo
config.help: One per line as Name = IANA time zone, for example Sydney = Australia/Sydney. The name is optional.
